metadata.description: FinAegis Claude Code plugins. Currently ships Defluff — strip AI-generated fluff from emails.

plugins.name: defluff
plugins.description: Reverse the AI in corporate email: detect AI / AI-assisted / human authorship, guess the prompt when AI was involved, classify urgency, extract 3–5 bullets of real intent. Mirrors the email's language. Detects invoice fraud / BEC, phishing, fake recruiters, and other scam red flags.
